component.name: WhisPaste
component.summary: Voice-input tool: hotkey, speak, paste anywhere

description.p: WhisPaste turns speech into text wherever you type. Press a hotkey, speak, and the text appears at the cursor in the app you are already using: email, chat, editor, terminal or search field. You never leave the window.

Transcription runs locally on your computer by default (whisper.cpp), so audio and text stay on your device and it works offline. A cloud provider is optional and only used if you choose one. No account or subscription needed.

ul.li: Small recording overlay with a live waveform
Searchable history, export as TXT, Markdown, CSV, JSON or DOCX
Text replacements for names and terms you use often
Import audio files; speakers in a conversation are separated locally

description.p: The speech model is downloaded on first use. Automatic pasting needs one-time permission for a virtual keyboard; without it, WhisPaste copies the text to the clipboard and you paste it yourself.

screenshot.caption: Every dictation in a searchable history
Smart Mode translates or rewrites text with a local text model
Notes with formatting, tags and favorites

description.p: WhisPaste 1.5: history, notes and settings are stored encrypted, a new Overview start page, quiet speech is evened out in volume automatically, and recordings, notes and snippets share one editor.
